items.html: And accordingly, it would have been proper that in ZA his Daat be below, in his body, and not in his head. And there we explained the reason of the matter: that his Keter is the Tifferet itself of Ima, in the aspect of a vessel and the light within it; and because his Keter is great in the extreme of worth, since it is from Ima, it had the power to draw and raise the Daat into his head, under the two Mochin of Hochma and Bina within him. But in the Nukva of ZA, whose Keter is only from the Tifferet of ZA, there is not so much power to raise her Daat upward into her head, and in her head there are only two Mochin, as above.
